Python-derived JIT utilities

PyTorch's string-conversion code derives through Julia from Python's
_PyOS_ascii_strtod. Its source records that leading spaces are ignored,
hexadecimal floats are supported, and Python tolower, isdigit and malloc
functions were replaced by C standard-library functions. PyTorch's slice
index adjustment code is adapted from CPython Objects/sliceobject.c, with
64-bit index parameters.

Sources:
  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d0f2af8b66b20da4baa50644c0cd3f887a2eae2e/torch/csrc/jit/frontend/strtod.cpp
  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d0f2af8b66b20da4baa50644c0cd3f887a2eae2e/torch/csrc/jit/runtime/slice_indices_adjust.h
  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/d0f2af8b66b20da4baa50644c0cd3f887a2eae2e/torch/csrc/jit/runtime/slice_indices_adjust.cpp
